app.name: Library Manager
app.initializationError: The library could not be opened.
app.previewDescription: Your files and devices are available in the desktop application.
app.previewConversionUnavailable: File conversion is unavailable in demonstration mode.

library.title: Your library
library.emptyDescription: Add your books to browse their covers, series, and authors.
library.dropDescription: You can add several files at once.
library.removeDescription: Original files, their variants and copies on devices will be kept. You can undo this removal from Activity.
library.removeConflict: The selection has changed. Reload the books, check the updated list, then confirm again.
library.removeRetry: The response did not confirm the result. Retry the same request to recover the removal without repeating it.
library.importDescription: Original files are preserved. The assistant processes new books once configured.

editor.title: Edit metadata
editor.seriesHint: Use one series for complete editions and split editions.
editor.indexHint: Zero and decimals are supported for prequels and short stories.
editor.revisionConflict: This book has changed. Reload it before saving.
editor.reviewPending: The analysis has prepared a proposal. Review the changes and their sources, then apply them to update this book.
editor.reviewDraftBlocked: Save your edits or reload the book details before applying this proposal.
editor.proposalNoChanges: The proposed metadata already matches this book. Validate it to finish the review.
editor.preserveOriginal: Corrections create a separate version and can be undone.

reader.title: Reader
reader.noSections: This book has no readable chapters.
reader.readerHtmlNormalization: The chapter’s HTML was normalized for reading.
reader.readerSvgTextOnly: This SVG chapter is displayed as text only.
reader.readerSvgOmitted: An SVG illustration was omitted from the reader.
reader.readerExternalImageOmitted: A remote image or an image outside this book was omitted.
reader.readerUnsupportedImageOmitted: An image uses an unsupported format and was omitted.
reader.readerImageLimit: Some images exceed rendering limits and were omitted.
reader.readerFragmentPosition: The exact position is saved. This secure reader opens the start of the chapter; use its internal links to reach a note.

devices.title: Your ereaders
devices.emptyDescription: Connect an ereader or SD card over USB, or set up a wireless connection.
devices.standaloneHint: Library Manager handles the wireless protocol.
devices.calibreServerHint: Library Manager opens a TCP server on this computer. In KOReader, connect the Calibre module to this computer’s IP address and the selected port. Calibre does not need to be installed.
devices.mtpHint: If an MTP ereader does not appear, mount it in your file manager, then scan again.
devices.label: Device name
devices.preserveProgress: Device settings and reading progress are preserved.
devices.inventoryUnavailable: No recent inventory is available. Refresh books when the device is connected.
devices.inventoryTruncated: This preview shows {count} of {total} books. The full inventory is still used to recognize books present on the device.
devices.inventoryNoResults: No books match the filters in this preview.
devices.calibreTransferHint: Transfers use unique paths and are verified after receipt. A network interruption may leave a partial file on the reader; Library Manager keeps a record to verify cleanup when it reconnects.
devices.inventoryDiscovering: Finding books: {entries} items checked, {books} books detected

optimization.removeImagesWarning: This profile removes illustrations from the optimized copy.

chat.title: Your library assistant
chat.empty: Ask it to research and inspect your books, check their metadata, or organize them with your permission.
chat.placeholder: What would you like to do with your library?
chat.noSelectedBooks: Select books in the library to analyze or organize them.
chat.selectionTooLarge: Choose up to {count} books for a bulk action.
chat.allowChanges: Allow the assistant to edit and organize selected books
chat.allowChangesScope: This permission applies to this request and only to the selected books. Original files are preserved.
chat.contextSample: The assistant receives a preview of {sample} of the {count} selected books. If you allow changes, it can act on the full selection, with a limit of eight steps per response.
chat.openSelected: Open book details to review its metadata
chat.thinking: The assistant is preparing its answer…
chat.noModel: Choose a provider and model in settings.

providers.title: AI providers
providers.noModels: No models available. Check the configuration and refresh.

settings.title: Settings
settings.webEnabled: Allow the assistant to search the Internet
settings.confidenceHint: Less certain proposals are left for review.
settings.secretHint: Keys are never added to books or the catalog.
settings.noKeyring: The Linux keyring is unavailable. Use a key for this session.

jobs.title: Activity
jobs.undoDescription: This operation’s changes will be undone. Library Manager checks that the data has not changed since the operation.
jobs.undoConflict: Files have changed since this operation. Undo has been paused.
jobs.deviceIndexResultTruncated: The inventory preview is limited; all books are still included when checking device presence.
jobs.calibrePartialTransferPossible: The connection was interrupted during a transfer. A partial file may remain on the reader; cleanup will be checked when this same reader reconnects.

errors.invalidInput: A value is invalid. Check the information you entered.
errors.notFound: This item is no longer available.
errors.unsupportedFormat: This format is not supported for this operation.
errors.encryptedBook: This book is protected. Use a DRM-free edition.
errors.invalidEpub: The EPUB file is incomplete or invalid.
errors.unsafePath: This file or folder cannot be used.
errors.revisionConflict: The book has changed since you opened it. Reload it.
errors.deviceDisconnected: The ereader was disconnected. Reconnect it to continue.
errors.insufficientSpace: There is not enough free space.
errors.networkUnavailable: The network is unavailable. The task will resume when reconnected.
errors.providerNotConfigured: Set up a provider and model to use the assistant.
errors.providerError: The AI provider did not return a usable response.
errors.rateLimited: The provider limit has been reached. Try again after the indicated delay.
errors.conversionFailed: Conversion failed. The original file is preserved.
errors.operationConflict: The data has changed. This operation cannot be applied.
errors.internal: An error occurred. Try again or check the details.
errors.profileInUse: This library is already open in another Library Manager window. Return to that window or close it before trying again.

providerDiagnostics.authenticationRejected: The provider rejected the API key or account permissions.
providerDiagnostics.requestRejected: The provider rejected the request parameters.
providerDiagnostics.requestFailed: The request to the AI provider failed.
providerDiagnostics.responseIncomplete: The provider response was incomplete or refused.
providerDiagnostics.noFinalAnswer: The provider did not return a usable final answer.
providerDiagnostics.metadataInvalid: The metadata response does not match the required format.

deviceLibrary.title: Books on your reader
deviceLibrary.description: These books are on your reader and missing from the local library. They appear as the inventory progresses. Search applies to books already loaded in this section; use “Load more” to browse the remaining books.
deviceLibrary.empty: No books to import among those detected so far.
deviceLibrary.loaded: Books loaded: {loaded} / {total} missing from the local library
deviceLibrary.disconnected: Reader disconnected. Reconnect it to browse or import its books.
deviceLibrary.identifying: Inventory in progress: detected books appear as they are found.
